# One9Founders
> India's largest AI tools, agents, and LLMs directory for startup founders.

One9Founders helps Indian startup founders discover, compare, and choose AI tools. The directory lists AI tools, agents, LLMs, and RAG/Vector DB solutions with INR pricing, editorial ratings when assessment is complete, and use-case guidance.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://one9founders.com
- Compare AI Tools: https://one9founders.com/compare
- AI Agents Directory: https://one9founders.com/agents
- LLM Explorer: https://one9founders.com/llms
- AI Tool Stacks: https://one9founders.com/stacks
- AI News: https://one9founders.com/news
- Submit a Tool: https://one9founders.com/submit

## About
- Founded for Indian startup founders
- Assessed tools use a 10-point security-first framework; unassessed listings are labeled Not Yet Rated
- INR pricing shown wherever available
- New listings are added regularly; research feed updates daily from arXiv and HuggingFace
